verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll has its own Workforce API (GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks). The documented use cases cover only a narrow slice of the UI: viewing employee information, deductions, payslips, pensions and workers comp codes. Nothing shows UI-level actions such as running payroll, tax filing, onboarding, HR approval workflows or reporting being available through the API, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: API coverage of payroll runs and auto-payroll, tax calculation and filing, 1099 e-filing, hiring/onboarding and HR workflows, timesheets/scheduling, reports, an explicit parity statement, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
